name: Clay brick
summary: This brick, decorated with a stamped design of stylised trees, tomb doorways and tethered horses, was part of the doorway of a grave. During the Han dynasty (206 BC- AD 220) the structure of burial sites was intended to mimic the architectural elements of a house, such as pillars, rafters, doorways
